handoff: Approve: the brief lists checks since the last report (step#attempt, outcome, duration, command, log pointer) in md and json, with the Rework check left out; B3 row added; unit tier and typecheck green. Minor F1: the window starts at the last done, not the last implement, so describe after qa/review gets no list.

findings.title: Window is 'since the last done report', not 'since the last implement'
findings.detail:
Spec: 'lists the checks that have run since the last implement'. checksSince starts after receipts.findLastIndex(isDone), so a review/qa report that changes no code closes the window. In the shipped workflows every step directly after a check still sees it (review after test, qa after test, implement after ci/ready). Only steps after a non-code report lose the list: describe after qa/review, and the test 'no check since the last report' expects qa after review approve to have no section. The issue's case (the reviewer right after the check) is covered. Core cannot tell which step is 'implement', so the generalisation is defensible, and the handoff records it as a decision.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optional, in a later round: start the window at the last done of a step that can change code, or keep it and add one line to the spec saying it was generalised.
